title: Universal Artifact SDK parity case
description: A language-neutral conformance case. Every runner loads the same files and reduces its run to a normalized observation; the `expected` block is human-reviewed contract data, never regenerated from a binding's current output.

oneOf.description: Artifact case: a final schema-shaped artifact, optional write options, and expected validation/report/output/model results.

stage_from.description: Blob source root, relative to parity/.

oneOf.description: Operation case: an ordered, language-neutral operation script that final-state data cannot express.

operation.description: A snake_case SDK operation, or one of the harness operations `prepare_file`, `read_file` and `read_document`. `read_document` parses an emitted YAML document, optionally narrowed by a `select` key/index path, and marks explicit nulls as `<null>` so a null value inside an opaque producer-authored map stays observable through normalization. `open_submission` accepts `into_session: true`, which continues the script from the reopened artifact so a later write exercises the reopen → write round trip.

expects_error.description: The step must raise. Exception message text is not a cross-language contract.

schema_valid.description: Verdict of the canonical draft-07 schema on the raw artifact data. A value of false alongside `ok: true` records a reviewed schema/runtime divergence (issue #32).

schema_error_paths.description: Instance paths that must appear among the schema errors. Sub-schema granularity differs between schema libraries, so this is a required subset, not the full set.

reopened.description: The full normalized model reopened from the binding's own output.

output.description: Normalized on-disk observation keys: files, state, sums, documents, disposition_markers, reflection.

steps.description: The full normalized step record of an operation case.

step_returns.description: Normalized return values keyed by step index.

raising_steps.description: Step indices that must have raised.
